title: Egg Bhurji
subtitle: Indian spiced scrambled eggs with onion, tomato, and green chilli
excerpt: Bhurji is what happens when scrambled eggs meet a proper curry base. Onion, tomato, ginger, and spices cook first, then eggs go in and are stirred through in loose, soft folds.
sourceNotes: Indian street food and home-cook tradition, widely eaten across north and west India.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Best eaten straight from the pan. The spice base can be made 30 minutes ahead and kept warm.

content.text: Egg bhurji is a fast, spiced version of scrambled eggs popular across India. The base of onion, tomato, and ginger needs a few minutes to soften before the eggs go in. Pull the eggs off the heat while they are still slightly soft as they carry on cooking in the pan.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for 20 seconds.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Add the garlic, ginger, and green chilli. Stir for one minute.
Add the turmeric, coriander, and chilli powder. Stir for 30 seconds. Add the tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes until they break apart.
Season the spice base with salt. Add the beaten eggs in one go.
Stir gently and continuously with a wooden spoon. Keep moving the eggs in soft folds over medium-low heat.
Pull the pan off the heat when the eggs are just set but still look slightly wet. They will finish cooking from the residual heat.
Scatter over fresh coriander. Serve with buttered toast, roti, or naan.

items.symptom: The eggs are rubbery and dry.
items.cause: They cooked too long or over too high a heat.
items.fix: Remove from heat earlier, while they still look underdone. The eggs will carry on cooking once the pan is off the heat.

items.symptom: The base is watery and the eggs slide around.
items.cause: The tomatoes released too much liquid before the eggs went in.
items.fix: Cook the tomatoes for a full 3 minutes until most of the water has evaporated and the mixture looks jammy before adding the eggs.

items.cause: The spices were added to wet tomatoes and did not fry properly.
items.fix: Always fry the spices in the onion base for at least 30 seconds before the tomatoes go in. Taste for salt before the eggs are added.
